projects.title: APEX Racing
projects.summary: A racing game that runs in the browser, with seven real-world circuits, eleven cars and a physics-based car model.
details: Time trials with medals, personal ghosts and a leaderboard.
Party mode: up to eight drivers race online from a shared lobby, with live positions shared across all devices.
I also created a 60-second teaser trailer from in-engine footage (video on the left).

projects.title: UES Underground Casino
projects.summary: A fake money casino I launched at school. It quickly grew a user base of ~50 players in less than an hour and was blocked by the school's IT.
details: Blackjack, roulette, poker, hi-lo, dice, mines, slots, plinko as well as Chicken Cross and Jetstream.
Everything runs on play money, and a leaderboard allows others to see their standing amongst other players.

projects.title: Game Night
projects.summary: A game-night site that runs party games on one shared screen while everyone plays from their phone.
details: Eight games so far: Codenames, Wavelength, Hues & Cues, Mafia, Hitster, Chameleon, Herd Mentality and Draft.
In Codenames, the board shows on the big screen while each team's spymaster sees the key on their own phone.

projects.title: Richards Cuts
projects.summary: A booking site for $20 haircuts in Exeter, New Hampshire. Customers pick a day and a 30-minute slot, and the booking lands on the calendar.
details: Confirmation emails include a signed cancel link, so customers can cancel without an account.
Staff manage the day's bookings from a separate admin page.

builds.title: Fishing organizer
builds.note: Inserts for the three tackle drawers on a boat, modeled in Fusion as three drawer components (15 bodies). Compartments are sized for specific gear, with labels like Leaders, Hi-Lo and Striped Bass printed into the walls.

builds.title: Home A320 Cockpit
builds.note: Created from wood and sim hardware, I attempted to remodel the captains side of a Airbus A320 in as much detail as I could.

builds.title: Fishing Desk
builds.note: A desk with hidden popup drawers that contain essentials for tying rigs for future fishing expeditions. Outfitted with tackle drawers, a pegboard for tools, and a line dispenser it is ready for any rig you could imagine
